responsibility: Declares the Modula-2 exception enumeration and the M2EXCEPTION queries that return the current language exception or test whether one is active. It is the public language-facing header for exception identity, distinct from GRTExceptions.h, which manages exception blocks and handler stacks internally.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration side of the GM2EXCEPTION pair: it provides the Modula-2 exception enumeration and the public query signatures, while GM2EXCEPTION.cc performs the actual mapping from RTExceptions runtime state and module initialization.
